parameter_reaudit.search_findings: Separate fresh total/active searches and later original research/card checks found no direct Turbo numerical disclosure or exact-model comparison-table active count. Secondary model directories variously list 744/40 or unknown and contain unrelated factual errors; they are not the evidence for these counts. Broad structural-change searches surfaced Baidu content-page assertions about distillation/speedup without an original Z.ai source, including inconsistent release years; primary-domain searches and the actual launch/training text did not substantiate those assertions. Such search snippets are leads only and are not promoted to specifications.
parameter_reaudit.lineage_assessment: The decisive evidence is the original Zai_org launch explicitly calling Turbo a high-speed variant of GLM-5, not family-name resemblance. Original exact-target launch/guide describe training-data and objective optimization for agent workflows. No pruning, compressed distillation, smaller backbone, expert expansion, routing-budget change or native modality addition is disclosed there. Under the nominal-lineage standard, the named relationship supports transfer of both separately published GLM-5 counts. This does not prove every hosted tensor is unchanged.
parameter_reaudit.counting_convention: GLM-5 Table 10 separately reports total 744B and activated 40B; it includes MTP-layer parameters and excludes word embeddings and the output layer. Preserve this published nominal convention without inventing exact token-dependent participation or component subtotals.
parameter_reaudit.access_limitations: Fresh X-owned syndication returned the original account, timestamp and full launch text; the prior direct X page returned 403. All eight independently refreshed originals listed above returned HTTP 200. No weights or weight shards were requested.
parameter_reaudit.remaining_uncertainty: No separate Turbo tensor count, routing-budget specification or exact topology is published in the checked sources. Both recorded counts are nominal base-lineage inferences, not direct Turbo measurements.
